pairs.target: hòumiàn liǎngrì , tǎ wéi zhàocháng qù tīngkè , huíwū biàn bǎ yào dài de zhǐ cáichéng xiǎodié , jiá jìn fángcháo de bùtào .
pairs.english: Over the next two days, Tavi attended lectures as usual; back in his room, he cut the paper he would take into little stacks and tucked them into a moistureproof cloth sleeve.
pairs.hanzi: 后面两日，塔维照常去听课，回屋便把要带的纸裁成小叠，夹进防潮的布套。

pairs.target: chūfā nàtiān , tā xǐng de bǐ zhōng zǎo , tiān hái àn zhe , lóuxià què yǐjīng yǒurén zài sǎodì .
pairs.english: On departure day, he woke early, before the bell; the sky was still dark, but someone was already sweeping downstairs.
pairs.hanzi: 出发那天，他醒得比钟早，天还暗着，楼下却已经有人在扫地。

pairs.target: tā bǎ chuángbiān nà zhī wǎn shōu jìn guì lǐ , guānmén shí kàn le yìyǎn zhuōzi , kōng chūlái de dìfāng bǐ xiǎngxiàng zhōng dà .
pairs.english: He put the bowl beside his bed into the cabinet and glanced once at the desk as he shut the door; the empty space was larger than he had imagined.
pairs.hanzi: 他把床边那只碗收进柜里，关门时看了一眼桌子，空出来的地方比想象中大。

pairs.target: pà wò zài lóutīkǒu děng tā , tóufa yìbiān yāpíng , yìbiān luàn qiào , xiàng yèlǐ zhǐ shuì le bàngè nǎodài .
pairs.english: Pavo waited by the stairs, his hair flat on one side and sticking up on the other, as though only half his brain had slept through the night.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃在楼梯口等他，头发一边压平，一边乱翘，像夜里只睡了半个脑袋。

pairs.target: tā dì lái yíkuài gānbù , shuō shì bèiyòng de , méi jiè , búbì gé zhe jǐzuò shān diànjìzhe huán .
pairs.english: He handed over a dry cloth, saying it was a spare, a gift rather than a loan, so there was no need to think about returning it across several mountains.
pairs.hanzi: 他递来一块干布，说是备用的，没借，不必隔着几座山惦记着还。

alignment.english: a gift rather than a loan

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò qù , wèn tā zěnme bù duō shuì huìer .
pairs.english: Tavi accepted it and asked why he hadn't slept longer.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过去，问他怎么不多睡会儿。

pairs.target: " shuìzháo le méi rén zhīdào wǒ lái sòng guò . "
pairs.english: “If I'd stayed asleep, nobody would know I came to see you off.”
pairs.hanzi: “睡着了没人知道我来送过。”

pairs.target: pà wò shuōwán dǎlegè hāqian , gēn tā zǒu dào ménkǒu , què méiyǒu zài wǎng wài gēn , shuō hái děi huíqù zhàn nà zhī búlòushuǐ de liǎnpén .
pairs.english: Pavo gave a yawn after saying this and walked him to the door, then went no farther, saying he had to get back and claim the washbasin that didn’t leak.
pairs.hanzi: 帕沃说完打了个哈欠，跟他走到门口，却没有再往外跟，说还得回去占那只不漏水的脸盆。

pairs.target: tāmen zài ménbiān pèng le pèng jiān , shuí yě méi tūrán duōchū yìchángchuàn huà .
pairs.english: They bumped shoulders by the door, neither suddenly finding a long speech to make.
pairs.hanzi: 他们在门边碰了碰肩，谁也没突然多出一长串话。

pairs.target: nài lěi yǐjīng děng zài jiējiǎo , bèizhe jiù pídài , shǒulǐ tí de zhǐtǒng wài duō guǒ le yìcéng yóubù .
pairs.english: Nerai was already waiting at the corner with her old leather bag on her back; an extra layer of oilcloth wrapped around the paper tube she carried in her hand.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾已经等在街角，背着旧皮袋，手里提的纸筒外多裹了一层油布。

pairs.target: tā kàn le kàn tǎ wéi de bāo , méi tì tā jiěkāi , zhǐ jiào tā zìjǐ shìshì jiāndài lēi bu lēi , zài bǎ èrshísì wén fàngdào tā shǒulǐ .
pairs.english: She looked at Tavi’s pack without undoing it for him, only asked him to check for himself whether the shoulder straps pinched, then placed twenty-four coppers in his hand.
pairs.hanzi: 她看了看塔维的包，没替他解开，只叫他自己试试肩带勒不勒，再把二十四文放到他手里。

pairs.english: This was two days’ wages drawn in advance; he counted it, put it in an inner pocket, and did not mix it with travel expenses.
pairs.hanzi: 这是先领的两日工钱，他数过，装进内袋，没有跟路费混放。

pairs.english: Passing shops not yet fully open, they headed down the southern slope; early vegetable carts led the way, and a mule snorted every few steps.
pairs.hanzi: 穿过尚未开全的铺子，他们从南边下坡，赶早的菜车在前面，一头骡子走几步就打个响鼻。

pairs.english: Previously, when Tavi saw such carts he always looked at the axle first; walking alongside today, he noticed the driver kept avoiding a loose stone on the right.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维从前看这样的车，总先看车轴；今天走在旁边，才发现驾车人一直避着右侧的一块碎石。

pairs.english: That stone was only fist-sized, but lodged in a narrow spot where a wheel could only pass close to the wall, so the carts behind paused too.
pairs.hanzi: 那石头只有拳头大，却卡在轮子贴墙才过得去的窄处，后面的车便跟着停了一下。

pairs.english: Only after asking the cart's owner did Nerai and Tavi move the stone to the foot of the wall, without kicking it downhill.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾向车主问过，才同塔维把石头挪到墙脚，没往坡下踢。

pairs.target: chēzhǔ shì gè dài jiù zhānmào de nánrén , dào le xiè , yòu wèn tāmen shìbushì yě qù nánpō yìzhàn , ruò tónglù , kě bǎ yígèbāo fàngzài chēwěi .
pairs.english: The owner was a man wearing an old felt hat; he thanked them and asked whether they too were going to the south-slope post station; if sharing the route, they could put a pack on the back of his cart.
pairs.hanzi: 车主是个戴旧毡帽的男人，道了谢，又问他们是不是也去南坡驿站，若同路，可把一个包放在车尾。

alignment.english: on the back of his cart

pairs.english: Nerai said they would walk to the fork first and then see, so Tavi did not remove his pack, only helped lift the dragging rope at the cart’s rear; the owner then stopped to retie the baskets again.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾说先走到岔口再看，塔维便没把包卸下来，只帮着把车尾那根拖地的绳收上去，车主便停下重新扎筐。

pairs.english: Beyond the last row of houses the roadside suddenly quieted, though the city's hammering still pursued them from behind.
pairs.hanzi: 出了最后一排屋，路旁忽然安静了，城里的敲打声却还从背后追过来。

pairs.english: Tavi looked back: the academy was already hidden by roofs, leaving a small stretch of white wall higher up, and he could not tell whether it was the part he knew.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维回头看，学宫已经被屋脊挡住，只剩更高处一小段白墙，不知道是不是自己认得的那一段。

pairs.english: He did not force a recognition; when he caught up with Nerai, he found her crouching to tie her shoelace again.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有硬认，追上奈蕾时，发现她正蹲下把鞋带重新系紧。

pairs.target: " zhècì huàn wǒ děng nǐ . "
pairs.english: “My turn to wait for you this time.”
pairs.hanzi: “这次换我等你。”

pairs.target: tā shuōwán biàn hòuhuǐ , pà xiàng zài cuī tā , nài lěi què bǎ lìngyìzhī jiǎo shēnchū lái , shuō nà jiù zài děng yìzhī .
pairs.english: He regretted it as soon as he spoke, afraid it sounded impatient; Nerai simply stretched out her other foot and said then he could wait for one more.
pairs.hanzi: 他说完便后悔，怕像在催她，奈蕾却把另一只脚伸出来，说那就再等一只。

pairs.english: They continued downhill; the sun appeared above the ridge and lit the opposite cliffs first, while the road underfoot remained steeped in blue-grey.
pairs.hanzi: 两人继续往下走，太阳从山脊后露头，先照亮对面的崖，脚下的路还浸在蓝灰色里。

pairs.english: An old water channel ran beside the road; a trickle seeped from a crack in the rock, followed the channel wall outward, and dispersed in midair into thin white mist.
pairs.hanzi: 路边有一道旧水槽，细水从石缝渗出来，沿着槽壁往外走，在半空散成很薄的白雾。

pairs.english: Tavi had thought there was another road level below; at the railing he saw only a distant mountainside in the mist, so far down it seemed a different world.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维原以为下面是另一层路，走到护栏边，才看见雾里只有更远的山腰，低得像换了一个天地。

pairs.english: He did not lean out; resting his hand on his own pack strap, he stood there a moment.
pairs.hanzi: 他没有探身，手按在自己的包带上，站了片刻。

pairs.english: Another vegetable cart caught up from behind; the driver asked whether this was his first time this way, and he said yes; the man then told him to look farther off.
pairs.hanzi: 又一辆菜车从后面赶上来，车夫问是不是第一次走这边，他说是，对方便叫他看远一点。

pairs.english: A few faint diagonal traces crossed the opposite cliffs, almost indistinguishable; they were roads winding around the mountain, where the morning carts would not arrive until afternoon.
pairs.hanzi: 崖对面有几道淡得几乎分不清的斜痕，原来是绕山的路，上午的车到下午才能走到那里。

pairs.english: He said this side would be in shade then; with sunlight, they would have a clearer view back this way instead.
pairs.hanzi: 他说那时候这里便在背阴里，若有晴光，倒是他们看过来更清楚。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi kànzhe nà jǐdào hén , hūrán xiǎngxiàng zìjǐ biànchéng duìmiàn de rén , kàn yígè xiǎo de rènbùchū liǎn de zìjǐ , bèizhe bāo zhàn zài zhèlǐ .
pairs.english: Looking at those traces, Tavi suddenly imagined himself on the other side, watching a tiny version of himself whose face he could not make out, standing here with a pack.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维看着那几道痕，忽然想象自己变成对面的人，看一个小得认不出脸的自己，背着包站在这里。

alignment.english: whose face he could not make out

pairs.english: A mule bell rang once; the earlier cart’s owner rounded the bend too, a pair of smiling eyes showing beneath his hat brim.
pairs.hanzi: 骡铃响了一声，刚才那位车主也过了转弯，帽檐下露出一双笑眯眯的眼。

pairs.target: " kàn gòu méiyǒu ?
pairs.english: “Have you seen enough?”
pairs.hanzi: “看够没有？

pairs.target: gòu le wǎngqián nuó liǎngbù , hòutou yě yǒurén xiǎng kàn . "
pairs.english: “If so, move two steps forward; people behind you want a look too.”
pairs.hanzi: 够了往前挪两步，后头也有人想看。”

pairs.target: tǎ wéi máng ràngkāi , nài lěi zài qiánmiàn xiào , méi tì tā zhǎo gè bù diūliǎn de shuōfǎ .
pairs.english: Tavi hurried aside; Nerai laughed up ahead without finding him a face-saving explanation.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维忙让开，奈蕾在前面笑，没替他找个不丢脸的说法。

pairs.target: dào le chàkǒu , zhānmào nánrén wènlù shí , tǎ wéi cái zhīdào tā xìng cén , yùn de shì liǎngjiā pùzi de kōng kuāng , nánpō yìzhàn dào le biàn zhéfǎn .
pairs.english: At the fork, when the felt-hatted man asked directions, Tavi learned his surname was Cen: he carried empty baskets for two shops and would turn back at the south-slope post station.
pairs.hanzi: 到了岔口，毡帽男人问路时，塔维才知道他姓岑，运的是两家铺子的空筐，南坡驿站到了便折返。

pairs.target: tā de chē bú qù chì píng , tā yě méi dǎsuàn yīnwèi nài lěi zǒu de yuǎn , jiù bǎ zìjǐ jīnrì de huó huàn yi huàn .
pairs.english: His cart was not going to Red Flats, and he had no intention of changing his own work for today just because Nerai was travelling far.
pairs.hanzi: 他的车不去赤坪，他也没打算因为奈蕾走得远，就把自己今日的活换一换。

pairs.target: nài lěi gēn tā yuē zài yìzhàn zàijiàn , réngjiù zìjǐ bèizhe pídài , zǒushàng pángbiān nàtiáo shíjiē lù .
pairs.english: Nerai agreed to meet him again at the post station, still carrying her own leather bag, and took the stone steps beside the road.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾跟他约在驿站再见，仍旧自己背着皮袋，走上旁边那条石阶路。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi gēnshàngqù , xiǎngqǐ zǎochén ménbiān nà yíxià pèng jiān , bùzi yě gēnzhe kuài le xiē .
pairs.english: Tavi followed, remembering their shoulder-bump at the doorway that morning; his steps too quickened in response.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维跟上去，想起早晨门边那一下碰肩，步子也跟着快了些。

pairs.target: nài lěi zài shàngmiàn jiào tā , shuō zhè yījí gāo , bié guānggù zhe dītóu .
pairs.english: Nerai called to him from above, saying this step was high and he should not keep looking down.
pairs.hanzi: 奈蕾在上面叫他，说这一级高，别光顾着低头。

pairs.target: tā tái jiǎogēn shàng , shēnhòu de língshēng zǒuxiàng lìng yìtiáo lù , yízhèn qīngchǔ , yízhèn bèi shān dǎngzhù .
pairs.english: He stepped up after her; behind him the bells took the other road, sometimes clear and sometimes muffled by the mountain.
pairs.hanzi: 他抬脚跟上，身后的铃声走向另一条路，一阵清楚，一阵被山挡住。
